text_block_list.text: (Knock knock...)
choice_data_list: (Who is it this early in the morning...?)

(Who could it be this early in the 
morning...?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer...? Are you awake...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah. ...Good morning!

Today is the Shinzan Kinen. For her to 
visit without any notice right before an 
important race... Something serious might 
have happened.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, I'm fine! It's nothing, just—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: No matter what, I just ended up waking up!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Agh, I want to race so badly, I just 
can't take it anymore!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I'd feel bad keeping Blast awake by 
tossing and turning, so I stepped out. I 
thought you might already be up..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since watching Lala's race, I 
haven't been able to settle down at all."

"Counting this achievement, Lucky Lilac 
was awarded one of the URA honors 
presented to the most active Umamusume of 
the year—"

She was unanimously selected as the "Best 
Junior Queen Umamusume." Smooth sailing so 
far.

Almond Eye, on the other hand, had 
prioritized training up until today. It's 
no wonder she's eager to race.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Of course! I went to bed waaaay 
earlier than usual last night!
choice_data_list: Then shall we go for a light run?
Then let's go for a light run.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh...! Are you sure?

In her case, if she bottles up her desire 
to win too much, that drive might go 
overboard and she could end up with 
another late start.
choice_data_list: Just enough to clear your head.
Just enough to refresh yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's right before the race, so I thought I 
shouldn't decide on my own... I'm so glad 
I came!

In the cold morning air, Almond Eye ran 
lightly, her white breath puffing. I 
watched over her enjoying herself for a 
while—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—The 'Shinzan Kinen' is almost here! I 
wonder if a girl who wins a Classic race 
will emerge from here this year...”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You really love this race, don't you? You 
watch it every year, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's a race that's been especially hyped 
lately! There are plenty of "stepping 
stone races" out there, but――

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That "Gentildonna" won here and took the 
Triple Tiara too! I hope today's winner 
goes on to do great things as well!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man—phew... it's freezin'! As long as I 
get to watch a fiery race, that's enough 
for me...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It's finally time...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The meeting's done, I'm in top 
condition... All that's left is to run 
with all my might!
choice_data_list:
Before that... what's the most important 
thing to watch out for today?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh, review time? Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Focus at the start"! Wrap up all mental 
visualization before entering the gate.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Inside the gate, think only of the start. 
—To claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
All this pent-up emotion... I'm gonna pour 
every last drop of it into this!
